title: Organic Traffic Growth
description: Google Search Console performance jump after on-page SEO and content optimization.
content:
tendaindia.com saw significant growth in organic clicks through on-page SEO, meta tag optimization, and targeted buying-guide content.

Challenge

The site had thin, generic product pages with duplicate meta tags across categories, which was holding back its visibility on Google search results.

Approach

  • Full keyword research to identify high-intent, low-competition search terms
  • Rewrote meta titles and descriptions for every key landing page
  • Published new buying-guide blog content targeting informational search queries
  • Improved internal linking between blog posts and product pages
  • Fixed duplicate and thin-content issues flagged during the audit

Result

Organic clicks grew by 120%, as verified by Google Search Console data, with steady month-over-month growth in impressions as new content got indexed.

title: Search Rankings Improvement
description: Keyword ranking improvement tracked through Google Analytics.
content:
A technical SEO audit and content strategy were implemented for secureye.com, a security products and services website.

Challenge

Despite having relevant products, the site was underperforming in search due to unresolved crawlability issues and weak on-page optimization.

Approach

  • Ran a full technical SEO audit to uncover indexing and crawl errors
  • Fixed crawlability issues so key pages could be indexed properly
  • Optimized on-page elements — titles, headers, and content structure — around target keywords
  • Tracked keyword movement and traffic trends through Google Analytics and Search Console

Result

Multiple target keywords reached Top 10 rankings, verified through Google Analytics data. Over a 3-month period, Google Search Console recorded 72.1K total clicks and 1.49M impressions, with a 4.8% CTR and an average position of 13.1.

title: Born To Banger — Brand Identity & Web Presence
description: Branding and digital presence work for a premium event activities and entertainment platform in Delhi NCR.
content:
Born To Banger is a Delhi NCR-based event activities and live entertainment platform that delivers curated experiences for weddings, corporate events, birthdays, and fundraisers — from caricature art to DIY workshops and team-building activities.

Challenge

As a fast-growing events brand working with 100+ artists across five cities, Born To Banger needed a brand identity and digital presence sharp enough to match the energy of the events themselves.

Approach

  • Worked on brand logo and visual identity — bold, high-contrast, true to the "Banger" name
  • Gave the digital presence a clean, professional look that builds trust with corporate and wedding clients alike
  • Kept the branding consistent across the platform so it reads as premium, not generic

Result

The platform has successfully delivered 500+ events with a network of 100+ verified artists, expanding its reach across Delhi, Gurugram, Noida, Ghaziabad, and Faridabad, with over 1,000 happy clients to date.
